The valuation metrics also highlight extreme statistical compression, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of zero against a sector benchmark of 1.86x [E6]. The equity is pinned near the absolute bottom of its annual range at just 10% of its 52-week spread [E4] and offers zero dividend yield [E3], reflecting total market abandonment amid these profound fundamental headwinds.
